chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 223: The Secret Shop Auction
chapter_meta_description: A scholar leads Han Li to a secret cultivation auction. Surrounded by Foundation Establishment cultivators, our cautious hero must navigate a new level of social and economic warfare in the underworld of the immortal path.
og_title: Chapter 223: Han Li Enters the Black Market
og_description: The quietest victories are won with patience and a good lead. Follow Han Li as he discovers a hidden auction house for the cultivation world's elite.
twitter_description: Han Li steps into a room full of Foundation Establishment cultivators, ready to spend spirit stones and learn the secrets of the cultivation world's black market.
